# Identity v2

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's identity/v2 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.IdentityV2(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.identity`).

`Tokens.Create/Get` returns the SDK-owned `Authentication`. It parses `Token`, `User`, and `Catalog` together and preserves `Header` and the JSON `Body`, including additional response fields. See [authentication responses](tokens/README.md).

Keystone v2.0 was removed in Queens and works only on older deployments.

See [Python Proxy mappings](python-parity.md) for openstacksdk identity v2 methods.

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.IdentityV2(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Users.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Users.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.
